description:
## 1.40.0

### ✨ Features & Improvements

* **YouTube - Voice-Over Translation:** Complete integration of synchronized real-time voice translation.
* **Yandex Neural Voice (v2):** Added support for Lively Voice (Живой голос) with emotional intonation, automatic language detection, and fail-audio-js server request handling.
* **Microsoft Edge TTS & System TTS:** Ultra-fast neural cloud voices via WebSocket streaming and offline device TTS.
* **Player UI Integration:** Breathing/pulsing loading animation on player translation button, live generation time estimates (`⏳ ~30 сек`), and bottom sheet settings dialog.
* **Stability & Isolation:** Smart audio ducking, audio isolation for Shorts and background playback, and automatic stream reconnection upon network drop.
